answer: mesa tallies influence only as unbroken judged epochs, and zephyr signs one task slot per anchor each epoch, so one operator cannot ripen two heads at once. Under that anchor the first head counts after 1 signed epoch; the kth must complete k² fresh signed epochs. A lone newcomer pays one epoch; n co-controlled heads cost 1²+2²+…+n² serial zephyr epochs before all n speak.
